how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-feralas-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2844:obj:0: Locate the lost night elf girl.
rows.quest:2844:details:0: I am no good, ⟦13⟧. I was 'spose to be watchin' over my little friend, Shay, and somehow, she got away from me. I'm not all that sure what happened, really, but last time I saw her, we was walkin' through the ruins just north of here.
rows.quest:2844:details:1: Everythin' was goin' fine, but then I turned around, and... she was gone.
rows.quest:2844:details:2: Now I jus can't quite figure out what I should do here. Got any ideas, ⟦14⟧? I'm awful worried.
rows.quest:2844:details:3: Hey, how 'bout you go look fer Shay? Yer legs can travel much faster 'n mine.
rows.quest:2844:completion:0: Oh, I am so glad you found me! I must admit, I am a bit lost... But isn't this a beautiful place?
rows.quest:2845:obj:1: Escort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.
rows.quest:2845:details:0: Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.
rows.quest:2845:details:1: There is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.
rows.quest:2845:details:2: Inside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
rows.quest:2845:progress:0: I was gettin' worried 'bout ya! Thank you so much for bringin' Shay home, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:2845:completion:0: What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!
rows.quest:2845:completion:1: Since you did so much fer me, here ya go, ⟦16⟧.

rows.quest:2879:completion:1: You reach out to the cold surface of the Equinex Monolith...
rows.quest:2879:completion:2: BA small door opens, allowing you to reach in and take the artifact inside.
rows.quest:2879:completion:3: Beams of light fill the area around the Equinex Monolith.
rows.quest:2942:obj:0: Return the Sparkling Stone and the ⟦E20⟧ to Troyas Moonbreeze in ⟦E15⟧.

rows.quest:3063:obj:0: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.

rows.quest:3063:details:4: The Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. ⟦21⟧, get my revenge.
rows.quest:3063:progress:0: The wings of the Northspring harpies are black as the night; do not take your eyes off of them, lest they disappear into darkness.
rows.quest:3063:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦22⟧. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.
